config_name: XPS 14 — Core Ultra 7 355, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB SSD, 14" FHD+ 120Hz non-touch

specs.cpu: Intel Core Ultra 7 355 (Series 3 Panther Lake, 8-core, up to 4.7 GHz)
specs.ports: 3x Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C) with DP 2.1 + PD, universal audio jack
specs.keyboard_notes: Backlit keyboard, zero-lattice design, Gorilla Glass 3 palmrest

battery.notes: 70Wh. Dell's 27h claim (Nov 2025 lab test, Netflix 4K @250 nits) is exactly this CPU+2K LCD combo. Real-world mixed ~10-13h.

price.notes: VERIFIED dell.ca 2026-11-24: CAD $2,379.99 featured (est. value $3,379.99, $1,000 off Black Friday). CNET's as-reviewed config was US$1,350 base.

reviews.quote: It's great to see Dell bring back the XPS and do so with such style.
Matches MacBook Pro in price but not performance

praises: This is CNET's reviewed platform config — premium aluminum build, vivid design, strong Core Ultra performance per dell.ca owner summary
Up to 27-31h claimed video on this exact 2K LCD + Ultra 7 355 combo; real all-day battery
3x Thunderbolt 4 with DP 2.1 and PD — best-in-class docking for a thin 14
1.38 kg and 15.2 mm — thinner and lighter than the 2025 Dell 14 Premium it replaces
$1,000 Black Friday cut makes it the cheapest current XPS 14 door
complaints: FHD+ only at this tier — 1200p looks soft for a premium line; step up $1,300 for QHD+ touch
No fingerprint reader; Windows Hello face sign-in only (CNET con)
"Matches MacBook Pro in price but not performance" (CNET) — Arc iGPU tier lags
Limited port selection: USB-C only, no HDMI/SD/USB-A (CNET con)
16GB soldered; Dell's own review summary notes keyboard feel complaints and occasional hardware faults

design_philosophy: The XPS brand's 2026 comeback model: Dell restored the XPS name at CES after the one-year 'Dell Premium' rebrand, and rebuilt the 14 around Panther Lake efficiency — thinner, lighter, and dramatically better battery than the 2025 DA14250. This base config is the volume seller and CNET's test bed.
rating_notes: Direct CNET anchor (XPS 14 2026, 8.1/10, US$1,350 as-reviewed — same Ultra 7 355/16GB/512GB/2K LCD spec as this SKU). Ratings map the CNET review directly; no inference needed on core specs, inferred=true only for CAD pricing spread across tiers.
